name: 探针4：联网能力
script: var step = 0; on('doubleTap', function (c) { step = step + 1; if (step % 2 === 1) { var bad = httpGet('file:///etc/hosts'); log('probe-network 协议白名单 -> ' + bad); } else { var good = httpGet('https://www.baidu.com'); log('probe-network https -> ' + String(good).slice(0, 100)); } });
